contract.after: The catalog keeps conditionalMissing separate, preserves requiredMissing and optionalMissing, and still uses task_check_required for the conditional-only case. The renderer labels each list independently. Older v1 summaries can omit conditionalMissing.
contract.scope: Resolver dispatch, task conditions, pending authorization, SQLite schema and provider eligibility retain their existing semantics.
